description_expanded: Description Description 30A Beach House Rental, Mar Chiquita with Private Pool, in Seacrest Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways. Charming 30A beach bungalow with deeded beach access and saltwater pool! Clean, bright, and perfect for a beach-going family, our bungalow is just the place to make the best beach memories while still being tucked away from the hustle and bustle of the city. You'll be treated to a deeded beach access, as well as a golf cart, four bikes, and a private saltwater pool to make your days even more relaxing and enjoyable. The interior is filled with charming coastal decor, modern furnishings, and all the comforts of home, including a fully equipped kitchen and a private washer and dryer. When you want to relax away from the beach, you can step out onto the front porch. Sip a morning cup of coffee or gather on the covered patio to reminisce about all the fun to be had. Each bedroom offers a flatscreen TV, and high-speed Wi-Fi is included with your stay (great for remote work). Just 1.6 miles east lies Alys Beach, a gorgeous small town with plentiful outdoor seating at places like Raw & Juicy, Fonville Press and George’s. Continuing east another half mile, you’ll find Rosemary Beach, a wooded community where each dining spot, boutique, and street have a charm like no other. Whether it's a weekend getaway, golf retreat, or family beach vacation, you'll enjoy your time at the Mar Chiquita bungalow! WHATS NEARBY Alys Beach – 1.6 mi The Hub – 1.7 mi Camp Creek Golf Club – 2.2 mi Rosemary Beach – 2.4 mi Seaside – 6.5 mi THINGS TO KNOW Snowbirds welcome There is space for up to 3 cars in the driveway. Parking on the street is not allowed. BONUS: Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day!
